title: advisor-nudge mailbox kind, new signals, feature derivation, worktree delivery
action: Per 3cfd9980 and c80debd7 (see docs/history/slp-advisor-nudge/plan.md S1). In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/supervisor.rs: widen the three closed kind arrays and their guard test — anchors: `pub(crate) const MAILBOX_KINDS: [&str; 3] = ["intervention", "escalation", "urgent"];` (~:236), `const CAPPED_KINDS: [&str; 1] = ["intervention"];` (~:243), ALL_KINDS (~:247) and the all_kinds_is_the_two_sets test (~:245) — adding "advisor-nudge" so the frequency cap counts it (second nudge on same target_session+point_key refuses and names escalation, exactly intervention's behavior). Widen KNOWN_SIGNALS (~:250, enforced at ~:304,:391,:535,:698) with "budget-overrun" and "same-region-resubmit" per a8f4b8ab. At record time for kind advisor-nudge, derive the target session's feature from its live claim (claim -> cell -> feature) and store it on the row as an optional feature field; no claim means no feature field. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/prompt_context.rs: the hook returns Delegate for any linked worktree (anchor `if roots.worktree_resolution != "ordinary"` ~:144-147; gap comment ~:275-276) — lift ONLY the supervisor pending-delivery read (anchor `crate::verbs::supervisor::pending_delivery_for_session(root, sid)` ~:277-279 and the render loop ~:349) above that bail so a worktree session receives its delivery lines; every other worktree behavior of the hook stays byte-identical. Red-first: make the closed-set contract tests fail on the missing kind/signals before widening. TDD inline tests in the same modules.

truths: A recorded advisor-nudge row lists in pending and renders one delivery line at the target session's next turn boundary, including for a linked-worktree session
A second advisor-nudge on the same (target_session, point_key) refuses and names escalation
The row carries the feature derived from the target session's live claim at record time, or none when no claim exists
